Test Case 5: Deployment Execution Validation

Input: helmfile -e local sync (in repos/platform/deployments/metabob)

Expected Output:
- Deployment succeeds without errors
- Helmfile processes all releases in dependency order
- No ERROR or FAILED messages in output

Validation:
- Verifies helmfile can successfully deploy to docker-desktop
- Tests value cascading (common → local → chart-specific)
- Confirms kubeContext switching works correctly
- Validates dependency graph execution order

Note: This test requires docker-desktop to be running and kubectl context set correctly.
